jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
We currently have an opportunity for an HSE and Prevention Manager

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:
The HSE and Prevention Manager is responsible for defining, implementing, monitoring, and continuously improving the company's HSE strategy in accordance with Belgian legislation and Safran Group SSE standards. The role acts as the legally designated Prevention Advisor and leads the HSE team.
In order to ensure a safe, compliant, and sustainable working environment you will:

• Manage the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of health, safety, environmental, and prevention programs.
• Act as Prevention Advisor under Belgian legislation.
• Develop and deploy HSE strategy, policies and procedures.
• Conduct risk assessments and maintain prevention plans.
• Lead HSE training, awareness and culture initiatives.
• Conduct audits, inspections and compliance monitoring.
• Investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.
• Manage emergency preparedness, first aid and fire prevention.
• Participate in CPPT/CPBW and advise management.
• Ensure environmental compliance and sustainability initiatives.
• Lead and develop the HSE team.

Your profile:

• You are fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You hold a Master's degree in Engineering or Safety & Health, or a related technical or scientific field.
• You are a Certified Prevention Advisor (Level 1) or Safety Coordinator.
• You have a strong interest in improving workplace safety and wellbeing with a preventive mindset.
• You have experience or strong exposure to manufacturing or supply chain environments, with a solid understanding of workshop activities and safety challenges.
• You have strong planning and coordination skills, and you have a practical and problem‑solving mindset.
• You have experience in developing and implementing training programs, and in evaluating the effectiveness of HSE processes, programs, and procedures.
• You are familiar with risk assessments and safety audits.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or a valid work and residence permit). Please note that visa sponsorship is not available.

Headit is looking for an English- and French-speaking Sales Support Administrator for the Middle East & Africa regions.
 

Where will you be working?
You will join an international company based in Belgium, whose headquarters are located in the Aartselaar area. It is a forward-thinking organization that is fully committed to the future. Team spirit, collaboration and a positive working environment are central to the company culture.
 

Your responsibilities as a Sales Support Administrator:
 
 

• Act as the first point of contact for customers in your regions 

• Inform customers about import regulations and legislation, including shipping terms, transportation methods, payment terms, customs-related documentation, etc. 

• Coordinate the entire order-to-cash process 

• Work closely with Sales, Supply Chain and Operations to ensure that all orders are processed correctly 

• Organize export shipments: book and coordinate shipments, manage transport and customs documentation, invoicing and delivery follow-up 

• Monitor order parameters and inventory levels to ensure sufficient stock availability 

• Optimize shipments by configuring optimal loading plans 

What does your profile look like?
 
 

• You hold a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or have initial relevant experience in a similar B2B customer service, logistics or supply chain role 

• Strong collaboration and communication skills, enabling you to build long-term relationships with internal and external stakeholders across multiple countries 

• Highly organized and administratively skilled, with good knowledge of MS Office applications 

• An understanding of and/or strong interest in logistics (export, etc.) and supply chain processes 

• Very fluent communication skills in both French and English

As a Recruitment Consultant, you are in daily contact with candidates and customers.

Client Details

You will be joining the newest division of a global player in the field of recruitment, which has also won the Top Employer award several times in a row.

Description

• Attend presentations and meetings
• Approach a network of customers and candidates
• Persuade them to work with you on their recruitment needs
• Negotiate terms, brief them and advise them on their recruitment needs
• Manage the entire recruitment cycle, from candidate selection to offer management
• Participate in job fairs and universities
 

• You speak Dutch and/or French fluently and have an excellent level of English
• You are a driven, social and entrepreneurial person
• You can work autonomously while remaining a real team-player
• You are a persuasive and compelling person able to sell yourself and the company
• You are adaptable and can change your style of delivery depending on your audience

We are looking for a Project Engineer for an industrial company specialized in high-value plastic injection molding, with more than 30 years of experience manufacturing components for the automotive industry and operating as part of an international group. 

As a Project Leader, you will be responsible for managing automotive projects from product and process development through to industrialization and serial production. 

You will act as the central point of contact between customers, suppliers, and internal departments, ensuring that projects are 

delivered according to quality, budget, and timing objectives. 

The role requires close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams and strong technical understanding of plastic injection molding processes and industrialization activities. 

Responsibilities: 

 
• Manage projects throughout the complete development lifecycle, from concept and design phase to industrialization and production launch. 
 
• Define, monitor, and update project plans, milestones, budgets, and deliverables. 
 
• Coordinate cross-functional activities involving Engineering, Tooling, Quality, Production, Purchasing, Logistics, and Sales. 
 
• Organize and lead project meetings with internal teams, customers, and suppliers. 
 
• Support the selection and validation of materials, components, and technical solutions. 
 
• Develop and maintain project documentation, timing plans, and technical reports. 
 
• Act as the primary interface for customers and suppliers during project execution. 
 
• Identify project risks and implement corrective and preventive actions. 
 
• Monitor project KPIs and prepare management reporting. 
 
• Ensure compliance with customer requirements and automotive quality standards. 
 
• Support continuous improvement initiatives related to products, processes, and project management practices. 

This list of responsibilities is not exhaustive and may evolve according to departmental needs. 

 
• Master's degree in Engineering, Polymer Engineering, Plastics Technology, Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 
• Minimum 3–5 years of experience in project coordination or project management within a manufacturing environment (plastic injection or automotive sector is a strong asset). 
 
• Strong project planning and organizational skills. 
 
• Excellent communication and negotiation abilities. 
 
• Ability to work independently while maintaining strong teamwork capabilities. 
 
• Solution-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving skills. 
 
• Good understanding of manufacturing and industrial processes. 
 
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment. 
 
• Fluent in English. French and german is a plus.

Do you like to work in the heart of Gent city? We're looking for you!

Together with functional experts, scrum masters, UX designers and other developers, you will work in an inspiring, high-paced and fun environment. We work on software projects according to the agile methodology (SCRUM) and in close collaboration with our customers.
Role
As a Java developer your input will help shape the future of the company, we will count on you to coach other developers and steer our approach for various projects. You are able to work closely together with the business, willing to go the extra mile and love to tackle new challenges. You get excited about new technologies and are always eager to learn more.

Profile
• You have at least 3 years of relevant experience in any of the following technologies: Java, Spring Boot framework, NodeJS, designing and implementing RESTful API’s

• Also interested in frontend development? We work mostly with Angular, React and React Native.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Azure or AWS is a plus

• You are able to help set up the architecture for our projects, selecting the right technologies to serve the business need and review UI designs

• You are willing to develop yourself and learn new technologies

• You are fluent in English + Dutch or French is a must.

Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly? As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You follow the production planning and keep the process running efficiently.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

• You handle basic administrative tasks related to production.

• You keep your workstation clean, organised and compliant with hygiene and safety rules.

• You have relevant experience as a production or machine operator.

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your process.

• You are hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:00 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.
(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

Job description 

Looking for freedom and your own dedicated truck (after your onboarding period)? This is your route:

    
• 
        
What: National transport (tipper and curtain-sider) of steel and miscellaneous materials.

    
    
• 
        
When: Early mornings (start between 4 AM and 6 AM) for a full 10-12 hour day.

    
    
• 
        
How: Independently, punctually, and in close contact with dispatch.

    

 Requirements 

    
• 
        
Valid CE license + Code 95.

    
    
• 
        
Speaks Dutch, French, or English.

    
    
• 
        
An early bird who loves working independently and accurately.

    
    
• 
        
An honest team player who cares for the equipment and the customer.

jobs.occupation: Orderpicker – Rotating Shifts – Become an essential link at SKF!
jobs.description:
Ready to put your career in motion?

SKF is the place where you contribute to keeping the world running smoothly. We are looking for motivated warehouse employees who deliver top-quality service to our customers.

Your role as an order picker:
You are a crucial link in our logistics process. Thanks to your speed, precision and eye for detail, you ensure that orders are processed correctly and on time. Do you enjoy working in a dynamic environment and aren’t afraid of a challenge? Then this is the job for you!

Work schedule:

Rotating Shifts: One week 06h until 14h. The next 14h until 22h.

Full-time or part-time. 

For part-time: Minimum 3 days per week. Option: 5 half days.

?? No fear of heights
?? At least a high school diploma
?? You pass our tests on speed, accuracy, numeracy, language skills, spatial insight and attention to detail
?? You are physically fit and enjoy active work
?? Strong comprehension and speaking level of either Dutch or English

Job description 
 What will you do? 
    
• 
        
Play the early bird: The road is yours while the rest of the world is still hitting snooze.

    
    
• 
        
Embrace variety: Shuttle between regional clients carrying agricultural products, sand, gravel, or waste (no ADR stress!).

    
    
• 
        
Be versatile: Switch smoothly between a tipper and a curtain-sider like it's nothing.

    
    
• 
        
Build some muscle: A physical challenge doesn't scare you off.

    

 Requirements 
 Who are you? 
    
• 
        
You hold a CE License + Code 95 (crucial, otherwise things get awkward with the police).

    
    
• 
        
You speak Dutch, French, or English (as long as we can understand each other by the coffee machine).

    
    
• 
        
You are flexible, precise, and treat your truck as if it were your own.

    
    
• 
        
Want extra hours? Great! More hours = more cash.

Job description 

As our new Distribution Driver, you will deliver goods on euro-pallets to clients within your region. No heavy lifting required—you’ll be using an electric pallet jack!

    
• 
        
Hours: Full-time, averaging 10 hours per day.

    
    
• 
        
Schedule: Monday to Friday (weekends off).

    
    
• 
        
Stops: 15 to 25 customer deliveries per day.

    
    
• 
        
Start time: 07:00 AM.

    
    
• 
        
Region: Mainly West Flanders, with occasional trips to East Flanders and Wallonia.

    

 

 Requirements 

    
• 
        
Valid Category C driving license.

    
    
• 
        
Based near Gullegem.

    
    
• 
        
Experience in distribution is a major plus.

    
    
• 
        
Flexible enough to occasionally drive a delivery van.

    
    
• 
        
Independent, proactive, safety-conscious, and customer-friendly.

    
    
• 
        
Fluent in Dutch, French, or English.

As an Air Import Agent, you are responsible for smoothly and timely coordinating air freight and providing excellent customer service. You ensure that everything, from freight transportation to administrative processing, runs seamlessly.

As an Air Import Agent, you engage in the following activities:

• Ensure smooth and timely freight process flow.

• Ensure accurate and timely data entry into our operating system.

• Track and trace Air Import files as required. This can be either internally via exp.o or externally via airline websites or by telephone to
airline offices.

• Use Tree View on daily basis.

• Ensure timely delivery of freight to customers for Import shipments.

• Ensure documents are timely sent to customer or broker for customs purposes.

• Ensure accurate and timely client and vendors billing.

• Interact with our customers in arranging their international shipments, meeting customer service standards.

• Contribute to maintain strong relationships with vendors (airlines, trucking companies, and others).

• Meet compliance at all times to regulations. 

• Understand department process flow, constantly looking for areas of improved efficiency.

• Ensure all customers standard operating procedures are followed and updated in the DLSOP.

• Overseas communications, timely responses to emails and requests (internal and external)

• Meets company standards of 52 hours training per year per employee.

• Promote compliance in diligently following all company policies and regulations and performing the task at hand with outstanding
integrity and pride.

The Air Import Agent we're looking for:

• 2- 3 years of experience withing air freight (import specifically)

• Proactive attitude and well-developed organizational skills.

• Good knowledge of Excel and Word; experience in air freight/logistics is a plus.

• Very good knowledge of English AND Dutch

• IATA certification is a plus.

• A positive mindset, problem-solving ability, and a good sense of humor.

jobs.occupation: Corporate travel agent - Temporary (knowledge of Amadeus)
jobs.description:
As a Travel agent you are in charge of organising all the travels of the employees of the company

Client Details

International company 

Description

 

• Book flight reservations
• Book rail travel
• Manage hotel reservations using the internal booking system
• Work collaboratively with other team members to ensure optimal service
• Respond promptly to urgent requests and handle unexpected situations efficiently
 

• You already have an experience as a travel agent and you must have an experience already with the Amadeus platform otherwise your application won't be taken into account
• English is the most important language
• You ideally have a bachelor in Tourism
• Strong customer service orientation, with the ability to work independently and accurately
• Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
• Flexible, efficient, and a strong team player

Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly?

As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You follow the production planning and keep the process running efficiently.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

• You handle basic administrative tasks related to production.

• You keep your workstation clean, organised and compliant with hygiene and safety rules.

• You have relevant experience as a production or machine operator.

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your process.

• You are hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:30 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.
(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

Responsibilities

• Define and document clear requirements and standards for traffic initiatives within the program.
• Identify tasks, dependencies, and risks while reporting progress and bottlenecks to key stakeholders.
• Develop and maintain quality management plans to ensure project results meet required standards.
• Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure the success of various projects.
• Document technical and functional information in a structured manner to facilitate knowledge transfer.
• Contribute to the long-term vision of the ecosystem by evaluating new technologies and capacity needs.
• Collaborate with data protection experts to provide necessary input for impact assessments and risk analyses.

Requirements

• 5+ years hands-on experience in Business Analysis or guiding ICT projects.
• Proven experience working within complex IT environments for public sector or governmental organizations.
• Expertise in Process Mapping, Requirements Management, and Risk & Quality Management.
• Proficiency with MS Visio, PowerBI, JIRA, and Confluence.
• Proactive, result-oriented, and capable of structuring complex information with a critical eye.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to align diverse stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with passive knowledge of the other language.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with ANPR systems, camera technology, or traffic enforcement processes.
• Knowledge of DPIA processes and privacy legislation regarding data processing.
• Good knowledge of English for consulting technical documentation.

SAS Global (Scientific Allied Solutions) is an independent partner in animal health, specialising in veterinary diagnostics, autogenous vaccines and contract research. With various subsidiaries and our head office in Belgium, and an international presence across Europe, Asia, Jordan and Brazil, we support vets, farmers and pharmaceutical companies with innovative solutions for healthier animals and more efficient production.
 

To support the continued growth of our three Brazilian subsidiaries, we are seeking an enterprising Regional Manager.
 

What does the role involve?
 

Location: Paulínia, São Paulo, Brazil 

Reports to: Global Management Team 
 

As Regional Manager Brazil, you will act as the link between our Belgian organisation and our branches in Brazil. You will manage the day-to-day operations of one branch, support its further development and foster collaboration between the various companies.
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

• You will manage the day-to-day operations and further development of one of our Brazilian branches 

• You will optimise processes and coordinate production, quality, logistics and administration. 

• You will lead the local team and monitor budgets, KPIs and results. 

• You act as the link between the Brazilian branches and the Belgian organisation. 

• You foster collaboration and implement group-wide strategies and procedures. 

• You oversee strategic projects and support growth and investment initiatives. 

• You contribute to the long-term strategy for Brazil. 

• You build lasting relationships with customers, partners and government bodies. 
 

• You 
hold a master’s degree or have equivalent experience. 

• You have at least five years’ management experience in an international environment. 

• Experience in setting up or further developing an organisation is a significant asset. 

• You combine strong organisational and communication skills with a hands-on approach and strategic insight. 

• You are an inspiring leader who knows how to bring people together and take responsibility 

• You work independently and take the initiative 

• You communicate fluently in Portuguese and English; knowledge of Dutch is an advantage.
